body.purpose: Base size of the whole interface.

method.purpose: Method labels in tree, tabs and search.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Menus, dialogs, search results, floating panels.

components.name: Send Button
components.description: The one main action of a request.
components.css: .c-send { height: 38px; min-width: 96px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #3b72e1; color: #fff; font: 600 0.8125rem system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .c-send:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #3b72e1 86%, black); }

components.name: URL Box
components.description: Method and URL in one bordered box, variables coloured.
components.css: .c-url { display: flex; width: 420px; height: 38px; border: 1px solid #363636; border-radius: 4px; background: #212121; color: #f0f0f0; font: 400 0.8125rem system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .c-method { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 96px; border-right: 1px solid #363636; color: #6bdd9a; font-weight: 700; } .c-text { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; } .c-var { color: #3b72e1; }

components.name: Request Tabs
components.description: Text tabs with a blue underline, green counts and dots.
components.css: .c-tabs { display: flex; gap: 16px; padding: 0 16px; background: #212121; color: #b3b3b3; font: 500 0.8125rem system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .c-tabs > * { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 36px; } .c-tabs b { color: #f0f0f0; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px #3b72e1; } .c-tabs i { color: #6bdd9a; font-style: normal; font-size: 0.6875rem; } .c-tabs em { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #6bdd9a; }

narrative.overview: Laid out like a desktop API client at the user's request, with Kynova's own name and logo. Neutral greys, one blue action colour, and colour elsewhere only where it states a fact.
keyCharacteristics: Blue for the main action only
Method colours on every request label

rules.name: The Fact Colour Rule
rules.body: Colour other than grey says something true: a method, a status, a variable's state, the main action.

rules.name: The Sent-Text Rule
rules.body: Mono only for text that is sent or received.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces are flat; a shadow means the element floats.

dos: Controls 32px, URL bar and Send 38px, tree rows 28px
